title: Signature Heavyweight Oversized T-Shirt
shortDescription: 240 GSM 100% combed cotton with dropped shoulders and a boxy streetwear cut.
descriptionHtml:
Crafted from premium 240 GSM combed cotton, the Signature Heavyweight Oversized Tee delivers an effortless streetwear drape. Built with reinforced ribbed necklines and pre-shrunk fabric to retain its structure through repeated wears.

  • 240 GSM 100% Combed Cotton
  • Boxy oversized silhouette with dropped shoulders
  • Bio-washed for ultra-soft hand feel
  • Pre-shrunk to minimize shrinkage

title: Vintage Wash Graphic Oversized Tee
shortDescription: Acid-wash finish with high-density DTF chest artwork.
descriptionHtml:
Turn heads with our Vintage Wash Graphic Tee. Featuring custom high-definition DTF artwork that will not crack or fade, set against an acid-washed charcoal fabric for that authentic retro look.

  • 220 GSM French Terry Cotton
  • Fade-resistant high-density screen/DTF print
  • Relaxed ribbed crew neck
  • Designed for everyday comfort

images.alt: THREAD Vintage Wash Graphic Oversized Tee

title: Minimalist Embroidered Boxy Tee
shortDescription: Clean aesthetic with subtle tonal chest embroidery in premium French terry.
descriptionHtml:
A clean wardrobe staple. Featuring subtle tonal embroidery on the chest and an elevated boxy cut that pairs with any bottoms.

  • 200 GSM Pure Ringspun Cotton
  • Precision tonal chest embroidery
  • Seamless double-needle collar
  • Tailored for a relaxed contemporary fit

title: Classic Crew Neck Everyday Tee
shortDescription: 180 GSM breathable ringspun cotton designed for all-day daily wear.
descriptionHtml:
The foundation of every great outfit. Our Classic Fit Tee is crafted with 180 GSM super-combed cotton for breathable, cloud-soft comfort that lasts morning till night.

  • 180 GSM 100% Super-Combed Cotton
  • Regular tailored fit
  • Breathable, featherlight drape
  • Machine wash friendly
